claim_ceiling: Run Boundary V1 passes app-window acceptance against a deterministic disposable database. This proves the real local UI, export, accessibility, compatibility, and failure-boundary workflow for synthetic schema-faithful cases. It is not model-quality, deployment-fit, transfer, demand, production, energy, or live-workload evidence.

acceptance_fixture.label: [ACCEPTANCE FIXTURE — NOT PRODUCT EVIDENCE] Run Boundary V1
acceptance_fixture.database_location: A disposable database outside /Users/d/.model-colosseum/; removed after verification.
acceptance_fixture.construction: The committed fixture script seeded fixed IDs, timestamps, manifests, trial states, human scores, and explicitly synthetic outputs into an app-initialized empty disposable database. It then verified exact counts and labels.
acceptance_fixture.startup_note: The first empty-database app launch read local Ollama startup metadata and populated disposable model rows; no inference ran. The fixture script removed those rows and set the disposable runtime URL to an unreachable localhost port before accepted cases were viewed.

directional.evidence: DIRECTIONAL CHOICE appeared before its scoped coding summary and claim ceiling. [FIXTURE] Model A led Model B on three same-method human scores each; all six stable result references opened their matching synthetic outputs.

abstaining_incomplete_or_incomparable.evidence: ABSTAIN appeared first for completed_with_failures. Ordered run-incomplete, no-scored-evidence, model-failure, and constraint-failed blockers each disclosed evidence and What would clear this instructions. Failed, timeout, cancelled, and excluded trial references remained visible as unavailable.

legacy_or_provenance_incomplete.evidence: A missing immutable manifest forced abstention, preserved the legacy/unavailable provenance label, and left its clearly synthetic legacy output readable.

safe_derivation_or_load_error.evidence: A schema-valid missing judge identity produced an accessible Run Boundary unavailable message, made no decision claim, and left the associated synthetic output visible.

live_database.integrity_note: After an earlier direct SQLite verification read checkpointed logically unchanged WAL state, the final acceptance was restarted from a fresh baseline. Counts were read from disposable database copies; the live database, WAL, and SHM digests and copied bytes were identical before and after that final run.

launch_evidence.debug_override: MODEL_COLOSSEUM_ACCEPTANCE_DB_PATH is compiled only in debug builds, requires an absolute .db path, and rejects lexical, canonical-parent, and symlink-resolved paths inside the live data directory.
launch_evidence.release_behavior: The acceptance environment branch is absent outside debug_assertions; release selection remains the live database path.

app_window_evidence.evidence: The real Tauri window showed Offline and the clearly labeled acceptance suite; no benchmark control was activated.

At normal width and the supported approximately 900-pixel minimum, decision, summary, claim ceiling, scoped recommendation, evidence references, and the horizontally usable evidence/results tables remained readable without clipped controls.
At both widths, ABSTAIN remained first and all four ordered blockers remained readable and operable.
The legacy provenance boundary and the no-claim load-error state rendered in the real app while preserving available raw synthetic output.

accessibility_results.evidence: Decision status precedes summary and claim ceiling in reading order and uses role=status. Boundary export and load failures are exposed with role=alert and plain-language text; meaning is not color-only.
Native buttons exposed collapsed/expanded state, responded to Return, retained focus, and inserted disclosure content immediately after the controlling button.
The expanded disclosure presented separate UNKNOWN OR NOT OBSERVED, EXCLUDED FROM THE CHOICE, and ADVISORIES headings with distinct content.
Open result 1 opened the matching labeled dialog, initial focus landed on Close, Shift+Tab and Tab wrapped within the dialog, Escape closed it, and focus returned to the exact Open result 1 button.
